services.name: Adult pickleball
services.desc: In recognition of his decades of selfless service to the Somerville community, the Mayor and Borough Council named the courts in honor of Kenneth Cornell, a lifelong Somerville resident and Citizen of the Year (2010). Ken served on the Board of Education for 44 years and dedicated over 30 years to the Recreation Commission. He also helped create the Ken Cornell Wheel Park (skateboard park) in 2000. The courts sit on the same Veterans Memorial Drive location where the skate park once stood. Ken passed away in 2025, and his legacy lives on here.
